collectible:2.text: Firefly pendants are one of the four categories of collectibles that can be found scattered throughout the single-player campaign in The Last of Us. They belong to members of a militia group called the Fireflies. There are a total of 31 Firefly Pendants. Each pendant has a name printed on it, signifying that the person wearing it is (or was) a member. As such, they serve the same purpose as dog tags.

collectible:4.text: Training manuals are one of the four categories of collectibles that can be found in The Last of Us and The Last of Us Part II. In Part I, there is a total of twelve manuals to collect, and they allow Joel to craft more powerful items. In Part II, they are collected by both Abby and Ellie, and unlock their supplement trees which the player can then upgrade. Training manuals help improve crafts.
